create_matchgenerator: create a MatchGenerator instance with home races, away races, and map names for StarCraft II match setups
generate_match: generate a random Match with home race, away race, and map name for a given opponent bot
review_matchgenerator_init: review the MatchGenerator __init__ to validate that home races, away races, and map names are non-empty
refactor_matchgenerator_generate: refactor the MatchGenerator generate method to support competitor opponents in addition to built-in bots
summarize_match_namedtuple: summarize the Match namedtuple structure with fields home_race, away_race, and map_name
